goals: Keep GrabAndGo 1.0.1 carried-entity rendering functional on Minecraft Java 26.2 by assigning safe identity to its otherwise unassigned client-created synthetic entities before render-state extraction.

Preserve the actual carried Ribbit and other supported entity models across first-person, third-person, shadow, GUI picture-in-picture, shader, and ordinary world renderer passes without suppressing rendering or changing real entity behavior.
scope: Maintain a narrow client-only Fabric mixin that replaces only GrabAndGo's shared synthetic-entity cache implementation and assigns one stable, unique negative render-only ID when a newly cached entity still has Minecraft 26.2's zero sentinel.

Pin build and compatibility evidence to public GrabAndGo coordinate maven.modrinth:199VyzmC:STumnqJf, embedded mod ID grapandgo, version 1.0.1, and SHA-256 9360863791c9e2f898de7abf5c2a671343fa47b793fadd51cc41bf254ef5bb64.

Maintain reproducible Canary 2 source, exact public-binary and Minecraft bytecode contracts, production Knot/Mixin application coverage for both carried render paths, focused visual procedure, and a small client-only release. Target only ribbits:ribbit and ribbits:wandering_ribbit via extracted registry identity; translate only their carried draw with independent first/third-person values and balanced pose handling.

exclusions: Global Entity.getId or renderer suppression, client-world insertion, entity-tracker or networking mutation, carried NBT mutation, persistent-data migration, and changes to GrabAndGo or Ribbits payloads are outside this patch.
GrabAndGo 1.0.1's independent GrabAndGo_CarriedData STRING-versus-COMPOUND save/load warning is documented but deliberately not rewritten without verified lossless old/new/corrupt migration fixtures.

Test Instance Manager state, dedicated-profile deployment, Minecraft gameplay claims, occupied-slot mutation, and all access to the protected Matcha Flavoured 26.1.2 profile are outside this source/build checkpoint.
